cover.title: Isidore String Quartet with Jeremy Denk
cover.subtitle: Piano
cover.pressQuote: A focus and command beyond their years—the sweeping coherence and blazing virtuosity of their narrative had the audience leaping to their feet. Violinist.com

sections.title: Welcome
sections.quote: Next-generation standouts the Isidore Quartet team with pianist Jeremy Denk for Brahms' Piano Quintet—the Isidores' emotional directness in electric stylistic interplay with Denk's searching restraint, preceded by Britten and Mendelssohn.
body: ADRIAN STEELE violin PHOENIX AVALON violin DEVIN MOORE viola JOSHUA McCLENDON cello With JEREMY DENK piano Next-generation standouts, the Isidore Quartet are at an exhilarating place in their career: competition wins and young-artist accolades launched them, and now, their programmatic voice, technical mastery, and passion for sharing chamber music with a wide audience have put them among the most in-demand artists on the scene. After Britten's witty neoclassical Divertimenti and the grief-stricken outcry of Mendelssohn's Quartet in F minor, they team with pianist Jeremy Denk for Brahms' Piano Quintet. Piano and quartet face equal demands in this masterpiece, and the artists offer an electric stylistic interplay: the Isidores' emotional directness in conversation with Denk's searching restraint.
